name: WorkInstructionViewer
tagline: Digital work instructions with CTQ capture, torque/spec checks, sign-off and revision control.
description: Shop-floor PCF control that executes released work instructions step by step: illustrated steps, safety callouts, number/torque/select/check inputs with live PASS/OUT OF SPEC verdicts, block or deviation handling, supervisor sign-off, superseded-revision blocking and a structured execution record per serial. Works in Canvas, Model-driven and Power Pages.
features: Guided or list layout with step navigator
CTQ inputs with spec text and torque gauge
Block or deviation (NCR) handling for out-of-spec values
CTQ results table and ctqDataJson output
